title.ja: 節点・表現・丸めを分けるRunge補間
title.en: Runge interpolation: nodes, representation and rounding

summary.ja: Runge関数と絶対値関数を等間隔・Lobatto型の固定節点で補間し、Clenshaw評価と比較します。
summary.en: Interpolate the Runge and absolute-value functions on fixed equispaced and Lobatto-like nodes, and compare with Clenshaw evaluation.

assumptions.ja: 無次元区間[-1,1]、次数8・16・32、固定2048中点。節点・データ・重みは実際のbinary64値を対象にします。
assumptions.en: Dimensionless interval [-1,1], degrees 8, 16 and 32, and 2048 fixed midpoints. Actual binary64 nodes, data and weights define the discrete problem.

algorithm.ja: 第2重心公式と全係数Clenshaw漸化式を自作。丸め済み節点上の閉形式重みと有限Chebyshev変換をそのまま保存します。
algorithm.en: Implement the second barycentric formula and a full-coefficient Clenshaw recurrence. Retain the closed weights and finite Chebyshev transform on rounded nodes.

validation.ja: 格納値の補間多項式P、閉重み有理式R、格納係数級数C、目標関数fを区別。17点の正確な有理参照・演算別誤差上界・節点一致・固定Runge傾向を照合します。
validation.en: Separate the stored-data polynomial P, closed-weight rational expression R, stored-coefficient series C and target f. Check exact rational references at 17 probes, operation-based error bounds, node identities and fixed Runge trends.

limits.ja: 標本最大誤差は連続一様ノルムの証明ではありません。丸め節点の閉重み・離散直交性は厳密と見なしません。任意次数・任意点の安定性は保証しません。
limits.en: A sampled maximum error is not a proof of a continuous uniform norm. Closed weights and discrete orthogonality on rounded nodes are not treated as exact. No arbitrary-degree or all-point stability guarantee is made.

references.title: NIST DLMF §3.11(ii): Chebyshev series and Clenshaw summation
references.review_scope: Selected E7, E9, E11 and E15 with endpoint-halving conventions; no original Clenshaw paper reading. The implementation uses full coefficients, so its final combination is derived explicitly.

references.title: SciPy 1.14.1 BarycentricInterpolator documentation
references.review_scope: Selected barycentric formula and interpolation-conditioning notes read during the preceding preparation. The Berrut–Trefethen paper is a bibliographic lead, not a full-text reading.

title.ja: 自然・端点微分指定スプラインとPCHIP
title.en: Natural and clamped splines versus PCHIP

summary.ja: 平坦部を持つ単調データ・3次式・直線の固定3組で、C2連続性と形状保存を比較します。
summary.en: Compare C2 continuity and shape preservation on three fixed data sets: a monotone plateau, a cubic and a straight line.

assumptions.ja: 実binary64の節点と値を使用。自然条件は両端2階微分ゼロ、clamped条件は入力端点1階微分です。
assumptions.en: Use actual binary64 knots and values. Natural conditions set both endpoint second derivatives to zero; clamped conditions prescribe the first derivatives from the input.

algorithm.ja: 3次Bスプラインの配置行列を解きde Boor評価。別経路でPCHIPの調和平均・端点制限とHermite評価を実装します。
algorithm.en: Solve a cubic B-spline collocation system and evaluate it with de Boor recursion. A separate path implements PCHIP harmonic slopes, endpoint limiting and Hermite evaluation.

validation.ja: 正確な有理2階微分系・有理PCHIP・SciPy 1.14.1を照合。端点15記録は16スカラー出力・13異なる入力。平坦部の負値は実binary64をFraction化した独立式で示します。
validation.en: Compare with exact rational second-derivative systems, rational PCHIP and SciPy 1.14.1. Fifteen endpoint records contain sixteen scalar outputs from thirteen distinct inputs. Independent Fraction formulas show plateau undershoot for the actual binary64 data.

limits.ja: PCHIPは通常C1でありC2とは限りません。一般データの最良近似・外挿・ノイズ平滑化は対象外。SciPyは原著完全閲読の代用ではありません。
limits.en: PCHIP is generally C1, not necessarily C2. Best approximation, extrapolation and noise smoothing are outside scope. A SciPy comparison does not substitute for reading the original papers.

references.title: SciPy 1.14.1 PCHIP documentation and selected source
references.review_scope: Selected lines 202–225, 243–254, 275–298: harmonic interior derivatives, endpoint sign and 3-slope limiter, two-point case. The original Fritsch–Butland paper has not been read in full. Own formulas are independently expressed as scalar Hermite polynomials.

references.title: SciPy 1.14.1 BSpline and CubicSpline documentation
references.review_scope: Natural and clamped boundary conditions and the BSpline recurrence were read during preparation. No de Boor original full-text claim. SciPy is a secondary numerical companion; the rational second-derivative system is the independent reference.

title.ja: Haar多重解像度の境界・シフト・閾値
title.en: Haar multiresolution: boundaries, shifts and thresholds

summary.ja: 長さ17・32の小信号に3段Haar分解を適用。1標本シフトと奇数長の境界処理を分けて比較します。
summary.en: Apply three-level Haar analysis to short signals of lengths 17 and 32, separating one-sample shifts from odd-length boundary handling.

assumptions.ja: 奇数長の各段で周期型は先頭、対称型は末尾を1点追加し、再構成時に切り戻します。詳細係数のみ閾値0.2を使用。
assumptions.en: At each odd-length level append the first sample for periodic extension or the last for symmetric extension, then crop during synthesis. Apply threshold 0.2 only to detail coefficients.

algorithm.ja: 和差フィルタ・間引き・逆ピラミッドを自作。閾値なし・hard・softの3条件を同じ解析係数から再構成します。
algorithm.en: Implement pair-sum and pair-difference filters, downsampling and inverse pyramids. Reconstruct with no threshold, hard thresholding and soft thresholding from the same analysis coefficients.

validation.ja: 12解析・36再構成。独立行列・Fraction/Decimal係数、完全再構成、二乗L2誤差を照合。長さ32のみ直交誤差恒等式を要求し、17点では追加エネルギーを段別保存します。
validation.en: Use twelve analyses and thirty-six reconstructions. Check independent matrices, Fraction/Decimal coefficients, perfect reconstruction and squared L2 errors. Require the orthogonal error identity only at length 32; retain level-by-level padding energy at length 17.

limits.ja: Haarに限定し長いフィルタや画像圧縮は対象外。一般の対称拡張に正規直交性を仮定しません。シフト不変性は要求せず、シフト別差を保存します。
limits.en: Limited to Haar, without longer filters or image compression. General symmetric extension is not assumed orthonormal. Shift invariance is not required; shift-dependent differences are retained.

references.title: S. Mallat, A Theory for Multiresolution Signal Decomposition: The Wavelet Representation
references.review_scope: During preparation: title/abstract, Haar example on printed p. 679, selected §III-B/C filter/downsample/inverse-pyramid and border-symmetry prose on p. 681. Extracted formula glyphs were imperfect; no complete proof or numerical-table audit is claimed.

references.title: PyWavelets documentation: Signal extension modes
references.review_scope: Periodic and half-sample symmetric extension and the redundancy caveat. This example defines its own append-at-each-odd-level/crop convention; it does not claim PyWavelets coefficient-layout equivalence or require PyWavelets.

formulas: E_after=E_before+padding^2; ||e||_2^2=||delta_coeff||_2^2 only for square orthogonal transform
